column2: Losing the Congress requires a government empowered to authorise military expenditure. In seven days, we will approve a provisional presidium, gain another seven days for the active government crisis and unlock paid establishment of an emergency cabinet. The free administrative procedure remains available immediately; a reserve headquarters prepared in advance retains its accelerated option.
Restore District Communications

After the Bronze Congress fell, some telephone lines disappeared along with their offices; others became more dangerous than silence. District couriers will receive routes, reserve seals and authority to answer to the functioning provisional government.\n\nRestored communications unlock frontline regrouping and provide 25 command power for one such order. They allow the rear administration and an operations directorate to be established without waiting for the capital to be retaken.
Block Kefreyt's Supply Channels

Counterintelligence answers to functioning rear administrations or the provisional government. It need not wait for the army to retake the road to Niansas. Specific paid shipments from Kefreyt can be identified and intercepted; losing the overland route halts delivery.
The Government Returns

The army must actually retake the Bronze Congress quarter: a government decision cannot replace victory on the ground. After the building is recovered, we will bring the departments together there, check the archives and confirm the district administrations' authority.\n\nResuming operations increases stability and war support by 5 percentage points. This is a one-time result of the government's return; losing and retaking the quarter again grants no further reward.
Permanent Security Service
The centre must maintain a permanent apparatus and pay for its work. Reorganisation proceeds through three payments and establishes a centralised model of government.
The Presidium's Authority
The presidium's authority consolidates the paid reorganisation. District concessions are reviewed upon completion; the emergency apparatus becomes a permanent expense.
District Reconstruction Fund
The districts receive their own programme of actual construction projects. Distributing funds requires the restoration of administration to be completed.
Agreement between the Cells
District participation is secured in a permanent agreement. Instead of a single security apparatus, the organisation adopts decentralised administration and local obligations.
Representation in Exile
The organisation retains its independent political work, but operates under Nodrul's laws.
Gather the Survivors
We will assemble active organisers and restore records of the survivors. The dead and arrested do not return by a chancellery's decision.
An Agreement with Our Hosts
Nodrul retains its army, head of state and foreign policy. Exile formations require its resources and separate payment.
Exile Formations
We will prepare the cadres of new units. Each formation must be paid for in manpower and weapons; the Party's former army is not copied.
The Price of Return
A Party restored by Nodrul will depend on the military victor. These terms may be accepted through a separate decision, or the organisation may continue its work in exile.
The Campaign of Return
Political and military preparation allows a separate campaign to begin. If Nodrul is already fighting Shabrat, the existing war is used.
Nodrul will receive an offer to accept paid aid packages. War and asylum are agreed separately.
Permanent model: stability +5%, daily political power +0.10, administrative expenditure +8%. Emergency district concessions are revoked.

Second Underground District Operation

A separate target and a separate deadline. The operation first establishes an administration, then consolidates influence and military preparation. Disruption in another district does not cancel this cycle.
Disrupt the Second District Operation
This response targets the marked district of the second operation. The reward is its disruption and local influence; no recurring loyalty increase is granted.
District Industrial Reconstruction

4000 treasury units, 56 days: one civilian factory in the selected district. Requires control and space for construction. Only one district may be funded at a time; losing eligibility refunds the deposit. An emergency cabinet remains a separate operation.
